Resolves #21526

Batches multi-column `Neo.grid.Container#applyResponsiveLockPolicy` transitions inside `syncingGroupLock` (propagating `headerGroup` siblings through a shared `syncHeaderGroupLock` helper used by both `onColumnLockChange` and `applyResponsiveLockPolicy`) and invokes `onColumnLockChange` once per breakpoint change instead of `N` concurrent times in the same tick.

Prescription checked: `src/grid/Container.mjs` — owns the concern (`applyResponsiveLockPolicy`, `syncingGroupLock`, `syncHeaderGroupLock`, and `onColumnLockChange` all reside on `GridContainer`). Change class: `restoration` (`fix`); `agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR baseline + Engine Tests ran`. Out-of-scope adjacent finding noted in `defect-note` `MESSAGE:36f5aff7-469b-4e42-a73d-6511ac0ab7df` (`CellEditing#holdEdit` overlapping-caller promise, promoted to #21531 / PR #21534).

Evidence: L3 (Playwright browser e2e in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/ResponsiveLockPolicyNL.spec.mjs` + unit simulation in `test/playwright/unit/grid/LockedColumns.spec.mjs`, both verified red on `dev` and green on `head`) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3 + grid browser e2e per #19777).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/e2e/grid/ResponsiveLockPolicyNL.spec.mjs` (`resizing across a multi-column + header-group breakpoint keeps target regions intact without duplicate bodies`) + `test/playwright/unit/grid/LockedColumns.spec.mjs` (`responsiveLockPolicy batches multi-column transitions into one rebuild and skips no-ops`) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/e2e/grid/ResponsiveLockPolicyNL.spec.mjs` (`resizing across a multi-column + header-group breakpoint keeps target regions intact without duplicate bodies`) + `test/playwright/unit/grid/LockedColumns.spec.mjs` (`responsiveLockPolicy keeps header groups atomic when batched with other columns`) |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/LockedColumns.spec.mjs` (`responsiveLockPolicy batches multi-column transitions into one rebuild and skips no-ops` + `responsiveLockPolicy leaves omitted columns user-owned and ignores invalid descriptors`) |

## Deltas from ticket
Extracted shared `Neo.grid.Container#syncHeaderGroupLock(column)` helper called by both `onColumnLockChange` and `applyResponsiveLockPolicy`, and added browser e2e `test/playwright/e2e/grid/ResponsiveLockPolicyNL.spec.mjs` (registered in `ADAPTER_ELIGIBLE_SPECS` so it executes in `E2E (engine tier)` CI).

## Test Evidence
- **Local browser e2e isolation (`npx playwright test test/playwright/e2e/grid/ResponsiveLockPolicyNL.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs`):**
  - **Red on `dev` (`origin/dev` `src/grid/Container.mjs`):** fails with user-visible column-order corruption (`Error: compact: region + Q1 leaves in center toolbar` — receives `['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Region', 'Apr']` instead of `['Region', 'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr']` when resizing across `{region: null, jan: null, total: null}`, because unbatched `region.locked = null` runs an intermediate `sortColumns` pass while `Q1` (`jan`, `feb`, `mar`) is still `'start'`, permanently shifting `Region` behind `Q1`).
  - **Green at head (`7de1f4f47b`):** `1/1` passed (`2.2s`), preserving `['Region', 'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr']` in compact center and `['Region', 'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar']` / `['Total']` on re-lock with zero duplicate `.neo-grid-body` nodes, zero duplicate DOM IDs, zero id-less `insertNode` deltas, zero delta-grammar errors, and `dom === vdom` across every `grid-body`.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] None required; both unit (`Engine Tests / unit`) and browser e2e (`E2E (engine tier)`) run pre-merge in CI.

## Commits
- `c3c858a23d` — batch multi-column `applyResponsiveLockPolicy` mutations under `syncingGroupLock` + unit coverage
- `7de1f4f47b` — share `syncHeaderGroupLock` helper across `onColumnLockChange` and `applyResponsiveLockPolicy`, wrap `@summary` lines <=120 cols, and add `ResponsiveLockPolicyNL.spec.mjs` browser e2e
